result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. The horizontally scrollable category chips and restaurant carousel with partially visible edge items, as well as the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, are expected behaviors and not defects. One minor visual inconsistency was noted in the promotional banner's decorative background.

issues.description: The decorative circular overlay shapes on the right side of the green '3 free deliveries' banner are clipped abruptly at the banner's right edge, creating a slightly unfinished look.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the decorative circles so they fade out or are intentionally contained within the banner bounds for a more polished appearance.
